note: Split the count->probability conversion level by whether a book priced the player. Fitted on priced players and served to everyone, the board summed to 4.60 expected scorers/game against 4.28 actual over 570 held-out games; all of the excess was the players no book quoted, published at 4.8% each against a true 0.41%. Unpriced level fits to 0.07 against 0.94 by log loss and 0.074 by calibration. Held-out 2025 aggregate goes +8.1% -> -0.5%; priced rows are byte-identical (max change 0.0). Ranker weights unchanged - conversion artifact only.
